title: Character Sheet Editor: Cosmo offers a mask when one area of a result comes back soft
description: Rescoped 2026-10-18 (Fabio): Area mode (Prompt/Area switch, SAM3 Detect, chips, per-area crop-edit-paste) is PARKED until after 2.1 - it stretched the timeline. Instead: when a Character Sheet Editor result comes back soft or smudged in ONE area (a tattoo on the back, an accessory), Cosmo offers the mask route the app already has - the user paints that area on the result card, Cosmo runs Qwen-Image 2.1 edit on the mask with the picture as a reference (Fabio's edit_011 proof: far sharper and faster than the whole-sheet pass). Blocker fixed here: the Route rule said a sheet is never the mask question. Parked Area mode design (for after 2.1): handoff 1a7f24fd in handoffs/.
